name: SameDiff converters, transfer learning tests

TransferLearningHelperTest.note: Was 2/3 pass, 1 fail. Fixed: TransferLearning.GraphBuilder.build() param corruption when vertices removed + ComputationGraph backprop NPE on null epsilon accumulation.

fixes_applied: TransferLearning.GraphBuilder.build(): when vertices are removed (subset graph), bulk setParams(origGraph.params()) corrupted origGraph param buffer because param layouts differ. Fixed by using per-layer copy when newGraph.numParams() != origGraph.numParams().

ComputationGraph.calcBackpropGradients(): NPE when accumulating null epsilon from a layer that returns null gradient for one input. Added null checks for both currentEps and newEps in the addi accumulation path.
summary: 47 tests run, 37 passed, 0 failures, 0 errors, 10 skipped. Two bugs fixed: TransferLearning param corruption + backprop null epsilon NPE.
